dedupe_keys.name: nrel industrial facility combustion energy use facility level from epa ghgrp

description: This NREL dataset estimates the combustion energy use of individual large industrial facilities in the United States. It is calculated from greenhouse gas emissions reported by large emitters (over 25,000 tonnes CO2e a year) to the EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program, applying EPA default emission factors to the reported fuel use by fuel type. Each facility carries its six-digit NAICS industry code, latitude and longitude, zip code, county and state, combustion unit type and unit name. For manufacturing facilities, energy is further split into end uses (conventional boiler, combined heat and power, process heating, other facility support) using the shares of the 2010 EIA Manufacturing Energy Consumption Survey. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): NLR data catalogue licence (Alliance for Energy Innovation terms: use with attribution and disclaimer). Access is free of charge. Caveats: only facilities above the GHGRP reporting threshold are covered, fuel use is back-calculated from emissions, the end-use split is a national sector average, not measured, and the data are from the 2016 release. For simulation it places industrial heat and fuel demand at facility level, useful for gas and electricity network demand allocation and for estimating which plants lose process heat when a fuel supply is cut. Related catalogue records include the EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program and the EIA Manufacturing Energy Consumption Survey.
